registration_origin: historical posthoc S1 ablation exposed; future targets only
discovery_cohorts_excluded: all original prospective trial outcomes occurring before registration

data_policy.source: Existing C03 original-source signed NHL SOG Gamma–Poisson collector; independent append-only research sidecar; no new scheduled tasks
data_policy.source_selection: First completed original same-day C03 generator manifest only, sorted by immutable creation/filename; do not inspect target outcomes for eligibility
data_policy.sample_limit: Source-selected original prospective collector maximum 4 forecasts per run; NOT full NHL population
data_policy.universe: Every source-certified NHL regular-season full-game skater SOG player-event with a strictly pre-event C03 original Gamma forecast and reverified signed source receipts. No performance-based selection. Only distinct player_id+official_event_id once for primary count study; quote contracts separate.
data_policy.game_scope: Full game including NHL official overtime shots; played-conditioned forecast; official DNP/no official played row is unscored distinct category, never counted as zero or sportsbook void.
data_policy.receipt_policy: original raw bytes SHA256, source URL, signed collector proof, ingestion/availability, exact player/event, roster, training cutoff, full prior observation manifest and new frozen input/source/model SHA; unverifiable => abstain
data_policy.quote_policy: Original quotes and payout semantics only, never reconstruct from outcome

model.peer_prior: Same signed, position-matched F/D prior-only C03 group and last-20 per peer retained; minimum 20 peers/200 prior played peer-games; original G-P parameters preserved
model.mean: mu=median(last up to 5 prior own played-game raw TOI minutes)*(a/b)
model.distribution: Poisson(mu); no rate-posterior mixing, no exposure mixing
model.m2: Gamma(shape=a, rate=b) mixed Poisson at exact same W0, immutable original mathematical implementation
model.micro_toi: Raw strictly positive played 0.05-minute TOI is legitimate and never DNP. Frozen Gamma peer-exposure bin abstention retained; no cohort exclusion for S1 alone justified as matched M2 comparison.

primary.metric: full-count discrete CRPS on exact paired S1 M2 player-games
primary.estimator: mean of per-slate-date average (S1 CRPS minus M2 CRPS), equal weight across eligible local slate dates
primary.justification: Absolute 0.001 CRPS ~0.14% of historical M2 0.714701 and ~20% of historical M2-vs-M0 0.004961 improvement; external design choice, not optimized on future S1 results
primary.inference: Paired date-level score differences. Primary 10000-replicate fixed-seed 7-consecutive-calendar-day block bootstrap of date means (whole-week cluster); 97.5th percentile upper endpoint. Pre-specified sensitivity: player-game pooled, game-cluster, and 2-week moving-block date bootstrap; diagnose trends and autocorrelation; do not substitute unapproved lag3/lag5 HAC.
primary.success: Only if upper one-sided CI bound <+0.001 AND >=60 scored slate dates spanning >=16 unique calendar weeks AND no source/time integrity defects AND prespecified calibration/tail guardrails pass. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or REJECT as warranted.
primary.missing: Keep candidate/attempt/abstain/unmatched/void/settlement-missing as separate denominators. Matched head-to-head only. No postgame lineup-derived eligibility.

secondary.contract_scoring: Only on genuine timestamped original sportsbook full-period quotes with verified two-sided semantics; 3-way over/under/push; unrelated to full-count primary test; distinct void/unsettled; never infer a universal -110 or EV
secondary.multiple_testing: No secondary confirmatory rejection; report effect sizes with descriptive clustered intervals only, no multiplicity-free promotion.
secondary.choice: No recalibration or hyperparameter adaptation during horizon; new research questions require a new future cohort.

design_power.method: Design-effect sensitivity only, not verified power

integrity_checks: Poisson normalized exact PMF, moments, zero and >=6
exit_decision: ACCEPT FOR FURTHER PROSPECTIVE EVALUATION only after QA; NONINFERIOR solely after locked future final look; keep original Gamma as control
rollback: Revert isolated research-only commit/PR, preserve immutable input/forecast ledgers; do not touch existing source archives or ongoing schedules.
